results.cypher: MATCH (p:ArxivPaper) WHERE toLower(p.title) CONTAINS "when does delegation beat majority" MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(p) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(q:ArxivPaper) WHERE q <> p RETURN DISTINCT p.arxiv_id AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2606.08098"}) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS answer_value, p.arxiv_id AS paper_id, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY title, answer_value LIMIT 25

MATCH (target:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2606.08098"})<-[:AUTHORED]-(a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> target.arxiv_id RETURN p.arxiv_id AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category, collect(DISTINCT a.name) AS shared_authors ORDER BY title LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2606.08098"}) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p <> seed WITH p, collect(DISTINCT a.name) AS shared_authors RETURN p.arxiv_id AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category, shared_authors ORDER BY title LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(target:ArxivPaper) WHERE target.arxiv_id = "2606.08098" WITH a, target MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> target.arxiv_id RETURN p.title AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, p.primary_category AS primary_category, collect(DISTINCT a.name) AS shared_authors ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2606.08098"}) MATCH (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id RETURN DISTINCT a.name AS answer_value, p.arxiv_id AS paper_id, p.title AS title, p.primary_category AS primary_category, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids ORDER BY title LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2606.08098"}), (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p <> seed RETURN p.title AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, p.title AS title, a.name AS author_name, p.primary_category AS primary_category ORDER BY title LIMIT 25

MATCH (a:ArxivAuthorName)-[:AUTHORED]->(seed:ArxivPaper {arxiv_id: "2606.08098"}), (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(p:ArxivPaper) WHERE p.arxiv_id <> seed.arxiv_id RETURN p.title AS answer_value, [p.arxiv_id] AS evidence_ids, a.name AS shared_author, p.primary_category AS primary_category ORDER BY answer_value LIMIT 25
